comment: information around in a sidecar object.

variables.name: EMPTY
variables.comment: The empty cue.

variables.name: DIMEN_UNSET
variables.comment: Note: We deliberately don't use Float.MIN_VALUE because it's positive & very close to zero.

variables.name: TYPE_UNSET
variables.comment: An unset anchor, line, text size or vertical type value.

variables.name: ANCHOR_TYPE_START
variables.comment:
* Anchors the left (for horizontal positions) or top (for vertical positions) edge of the cue
   * box.

variables.name: ANCHOR_TYPE_MIDDLE
variables.comment: Anchors the middle of the cue box.

variables.name: ANCHOR_TYPE_END
variables.comment:
* Anchors the right (for horizontal positions) or bottom (for vertical positions) edge of the cue
   * box.

variables.name: LINE_TYPE_FRACTION
variables.comment: Value for {@link #lineType} when {@link #line} is a fractional position.

variables.name: LINE_TYPE_NUMBER
variables.comment: Value for {@link #lineType} when {@link #line} is a line number.

variables.name: TEXT_SIZE_TYPE_FRACTIONAL
variables.comment: Text size is measured as a fraction of the viewport size minus the view padding.

variables.name: TEXT_SIZE_TYPE_FRACTIONAL_IGNORE_PADDING
variables.comment: Text size is measured as a fraction of the viewport size, ignoring the view padding

variables.name: TEXT_SIZE_TYPE_ABSOLUTE
variables.comment: Text size is measured in number of pixels.

variables.name: VERTICAL_TYPE_RL
variables.comment: Vertical right-to-left (e.g. for Japanese).

variables.name: VERTICAL_TYPE_LR
variables.comment: Vertical left-to-right (e.g. for Mongolian).

variables.name: text
variables.comment:
* The cue text, or null if this is an image cue. Note the {@link CharSequence} may be decorated
   * with styling spans.

variables.name: textAlignment
variables.comment: The alignment of the cue text within the cue box, or null if the alignment is undefined.

variables.name: multiRowAlignment
variables.comment:
* The alignment of multiple lines of text relative to the longest line, or null if the alignment
   * is undefined.

variables.name: bitmap
variables.comment: The cue image, or null if this is a text cue.

variables.name: line
variables.comment:
* The position of the cue box within the viewport in the direction orthogonal to the writing * direction (determined by {@link #verticalType}), or {@link #DIMEN_UNSET}. When set, the * interpretation of the value depends on the value of {@link #lineType}. * *

The measurement direction depends on {@link #verticalType}: * *

    *
  • For {@link #TYPE_UNSET} (i.e. horizontal), this is the vertical position relative to the * top of the viewport. *
  • For {@link #VERTICAL_TYPE_LR} this is the horizontal position relative to the left of the * viewport. *
  • For {@link #VERTICAL_TYPE_RL} this is the horizontal position relative to the right of * the viewport. *

variables.name: lineType
variables.comment:
* The type of the {@link #line} value. * *
    *
  • {@link #LINE_TYPE_FRACTION} indicates that {@link #line} is a fractional position within * the viewport (measured to the part of the cue box determined by {@link #lineAnchor}). *
  • {@link #LINE_TYPE_NUMBER} indicates that {@link #line} is a viewport line number. The * viewport is divided into lines (each equal in size to the first line of the cue box). The * cue box is positioned to align with the viewport lines as follows: *
      *
    • {@link #lineAnchor}) is ignored. *
    • When {@code line} is greater than or equal to 0 the first line in the cue box is * aligned with a viewport line, with 0 meaning the first line of the viewport. *
    • When {@code line} is negative the last line in the cue box is aligned with a * viewport line, with -1 meaning the last line of the viewport. *
    • For horizontal text the start and end of the viewport are the top and bottom * respectively. *
    *

variables.name: lineAnchor
variables.comment:
* The cue box anchor positioned by {@link #line} when {@link #lineType} is {@link * #LINE_TYPE_FRACTION}. * *

One of: * *

    *
  • {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_START} *
  • {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_MIDDLE} *
  • {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_END} *
  • {@link #TYPE_UNSET} *
* *

For the normal case of horizontal text, {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_START}, {@link * #ANCHOR_TYPE_MIDDLE} and {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_END} correspond to the top, middle and bottom of * the cue box respectively.

variables.name: position
variables.comment:
* The fractional position of the {@link #positionAnchor} of the cue box within the viewport in * the direction orthogonal to {@link #line}, or {@link #DIMEN_UNSET}. * *

The measurement direction depends on {@link #verticalType}. * *

    *
  • For {@link #TYPE_UNSET} (i.e. horizontal), this is the horizontal position relative to * the left of the viewport. Note that positioning is relative to the left of the viewport * even in the case of right-to-left text. *
  • For {@link #VERTICAL_TYPE_LR} and {@link #VERTICAL_TYPE_RL} (i.e. vertical), this is the * vertical position relative to the top of the viewport. *

variables.name: positionAnchor
variables.comment:
* The cue box anchor positioned by {@link #position}. One of {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_START}, {@link * #ANCHOR_TYPE_MIDDLE}, {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_END} and {@link #TYPE_UNSET}. * *

For the normal case of horizontal text, {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_START}, {@link * #ANCHOR_TYPE_MIDDLE} and {@link #ANCHOR_TYPE_END} correspond to the left, middle and right of * the cue box respectively.

variables.name: size
variables.comment:
* The size of the cue box in the writing direction specified as a fraction of the viewport size
   * in that direction, or {@link #DIMEN_UNSET}.

variables.name: bitmapHeight
variables.comment:
* The bitmap height as a fraction of the of the viewport size, or {@link #DIMEN_UNSET} if the
   * bitmap should be displayed at its natural height given the bitmap dimensions and the specified
   * {@link #size}.

variables.name: windowColorSet
variables.comment: Specifies whether or not the {@link #windowColor} property is set.

variables.name: windowColor
variables.comment: The fill color of the window.

variables.name: textSizeType
variables.comment:
* The default text size type for this cue's text, or {@link #TYPE_UNSET} if this cue has no
   * default text size.

variables.name: textSize
variables.comment:
* The default text size for this cue's text, or {@link #DIMEN_UNSET} if this cue has no default
   * text size.

variables.name: verticalType
variables.comment:
* The vertical formatting of this Cue, or {@link #TYPE_UNSET} if the cue has no vertical setting
   * (and so should be horizontal).

variables.name: shearDegrees
variables.comment:
* The shear angle in degrees to be applied to this Cue, expressed in graphics coordinates. This
   * results in a skew transform for the block along the inline progression axis.

methods.comment: Returns a new {@link Cue.Builder} initialized with the same values as this Cue.
